question: On existing TodoMVC/BrowserGym WebShop trajectories and the locally-hosted correlated FSM bank (N=1000-1999, no new Gate0 production SPAs), does an orthogonal falsifiable program — barrier/committor with ≥10 revisits to same canonical state (URL+DOM) showing divergent futures and calibrated committor, or timescale separation via autocorrelation lag structure — with trajectory-grouped permutation (unit trajectory_id, N=1000-1999, seed 42), richer DOM representations (visual layout via AX bounding boxes, computed style, event-sequence n-grams, AX-tree embedding, not SHA256 hash-truncated visible_text_hash/a11y), and analytic Dirichlet-Multinomial bias-corrected degeneracy, reveal beyond-memory predictive structure with valid null centering (|null_mean|<0.1, calibrated analytic null_std) and BC>0.05 p_bonf<0.01 gap≥0.05 over B-DOM-SIMILARITY/B-MARKOV-1 where independent-noise control remains BC~0?
hypothesis: On existing trajectory banks (Bio: 50 trajectories x40 steps =2000 transitions N=1999 locally-hosted correlated FSM with latent L per trajectory basin 0.70/0.30; plus available BrowserGym WebShop trajectories with DOM/AX trees at locked 1280x720, N~1000-1999) without new Gate0 SPA discovery, a barrier/committor operationalization reveals predictive structure beyond memory and ordinary similarity. Operational barrier: for canonical state s = (URL_before_normalized, DOM_rich_embedding_cluster, H_K=3) with ≥10 revisits, define latent basins A={0,1,2}, B={3,4,5} (or empirically discovered via trajectory metastability). Committor q(s)=P(hit B before A | s) estimated from branched futures. Hypothesis H_barrier: trajectory-grouped conditional mutual information I(S_next; DOM_rich_before | URL, H_K=3, Action_leakageFree) and committor calibration jointly show BC = observed CMI - analytic_DM_null_mean >0.05 bits with trajectory-grouped permutation p_bonf<0.01 (Bonferroni max 8, n_tests = n_R x baselines, floor 0.001 at 1000 perms or analytic p), valid analytic bias-corrected centering |null_mean_analytic|<0.1 and calibrated null_std_analytic>threshold (analytic Dirichlet-Multinomial variance, not permutation variance alone, with |perm_null_mean - analytic_null_mean|<0.03 consistency check), gap_R = BC_R - max(BC_DOM_SIM, BC_MARKOV1) ≥0.05 on ≥1 richer DOM representation (R_visual, R_computed_style, R_event_seq, R_AX_embedding), while independent-noise replication (≥6 variants/state) shows BC~0 (|BC|<0.05 p>0.10 |null_mean|<0.1) and IID null BC ≤0.03, and committor ECE ≤0.15 with Brier gap ≥0.05 over Markov baselines. Timescale separation (autocorrelation decay tau estimate, lag-1..5 MI) is co-primary orthogonal signal: slow regime L induces autocorr decay tau>5 steps vs independent τ≈1, with BC_autocorr gap ≥0.05, used if barrier revisits insufficient. Mechanism: richer DOM (visual/computed/event/AX embedding) carries latent L/session-state information that biases S_next beyond (URL,H_K,Action) and beyond TF-IDF similarity/Markov nulls; hash truncation 5k SHA256 lost this information, causing prior null_std degeneracy (perm_std 0.0097 scaling down with N). Analytic DM corrects smoothing bias without conflating permutation variance.
falsifier: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if with valid analytic centering (|null_mean_analytic|<0.1, calibrated null_std_analytic passes, perm-analytic consistency <0.03, identifiability ≥10 revisits per tested s on ≥5 states, H(S_next|C)>0.2) FORALL richer DOM representations R in {R_visual,R_computed_style,R_event_seq,R_AX_embedding} the primary beyond-memory signal fails: BC_R ≤0.05 OR p_bonf_R ≥0.01 OR gap_R = BC_R - max(BC_dom_sim, BC_markov1) <0.05 OR committor calibration fails (ECE>0.15 or Brier improvement <0.02 over Markov) while gates pass (positive correlated control BCE≥0.30 p<0.01 |null_mean|<0.1 analytic std valid; independent-noise BC~0 |BC|<0.05 p>0.10 null_std valid; IID BC≤0.03). This bounded-falsifies barrier/committor and timescale beyond-memory dynamics via richer DOM on existing bank without Gate0, not global Web production. MEASUREMENT_INVALID if gates fail: positive correlated control BC<0.30 or p≥0.01 or analytic |null_mean|≥0.1 or calibrated std degenerate or consistency ≥0.03 (pipeline blind/miscalibrated to constructed correlation), OR independent-noise shows BC≥0.05 p<0.10 with valid null (pipeline confounded), OR no s meets ≥10 revisits identifiability (Q=0, not falsification), OR H(S_next|C)≤0.2 (determinism ceiling), OR preprocessing fit on test/split leakage, OR resampling unit not trajectory_id, OR analytic DM vs permutation mean diverge ≥0.03 (degeneracy model mis-specified). SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST only if EXISTS R with BC_R>0.05 p_bonf<0.01 |null_mean|<0.1 calibrated std valid gap≥0.05 and committor/timescale calibration passes with gates passing.
baselines: B-DOM-SIMILARITY (mandatory ordinary-similarity null, director prior): TF-IDF cosine k=5 over richer DOM text (visual text + a11y names) fit on TRAIN trajectories only (70/30 split by trajectory_id), predicting S_next via nearest-neighbor without stratification; compute BC_sim via same Bayesian DM K=12-24 analytic+permutation; primary must exceed by ≥0.05 bits (director mandate). Also test embedding cosine (AX embedding) as variant.

B-MARKOV-1 (strong first-order Markov null): P(S_next | URL_before, Action_leakageFree) MLE on TRAIN grouped by trajectory_id, predicting without DOM; compute BC_markov1 via same analytic DM; gap ≥0.05 required.
B-MARKOV-K3 (history memory null): P(S_next | URL_before, H_K=3, Action) majority vote stratified; reports BC_hist and verifies H(S_next|URL,H_K=3)>0.2 not forced.

B-SHUFFLE-GROUPED (trajectory-grouped permutation null): 1000 within-strata shuffles of DOM_rich labels grouped by trajectory_id seed 42, yielding perm_null mean/std/p; analytic DM mean/std compared for consistency; valid centering |null_mean|<0.1 required; degeneracy triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsification.

B-INDEPENDENT-NOISE (recalibrated null with analytic correction): independent per-step DOM variant (≥6 variants/state, same FSM without L) with identical analytic DM + trajectory-grouped permutation; must show BC~0 |BC|<0.05 p>0.10 |null_mean|<0.1 to validate pipeline discriminability.
B-TIMESCALE-SHUFFLE (timescale null): time-shuffled trajectories destroying lag structure, testing autocorrelation decay vs null; requires tau_null ~1 and BC_autocorr~0.
B-TRAJECTORY-MEMORY / B-SITE-LEAKAGE diagnostics: exact (URL,H_K,Action)->S_next memorization ratio and href-leakage gap; not gating but leakage checks.

Transition P(S_next|S_current,Action,L) differs by L giving theoretical I(S_next;DOM_rich|C) ≥0.40 bits and committor q(s) ∈ {0.30,0.70} well-separated (gap 0.40). Must achieve with analytic DM K=12 or 24 N=1999: BC ≥0.30 p<0.01 |null_mean_analytic|<0.1 calibrated null_std valid perm-analytic consistency <0.03 and committor ECE≤0.15 Brier vs Markov gap ≥0.05. Failure => MEASUREMENT_INVALID pipeline blind/miscalibrated. Construction frozen in generate_correlated_rich.py; any outcome-informed change EXPLORATORY. null_control: Four nulls required: (1) Independent-noise replication RECALIBRATED with richer DOM: same FSM without L, DOM variant independent per-step draw among ≥6 richer variants per state (visual/style/event/AX sampled independently of S_next), 50x40=2000 N=1999, identical analytic DM+1000 grouped perms seed 42; must show BC~0 |BC|<0.05 p>0.10 |null_mean_analytic|<0.1 calibrated std valid (prior hash 3-variant BC -0.0056 std 0.006 degenerate; richer 6-variant should raise calibrated std >0.01). If BC≥0.05 p<0.10 with valid null => MEASUREMENT_INVALID pipeline confounded. (2) Trajectory-grouped permutation null on correlated bank: within-strata shuffle DOM_rich grouped by trajectory_id 1000 perms seed 42 yielding null_mean/std/p; analytic DM mean compared, consistency <0.03 required; degeneracy |null_mean|≥0.1 or calibrated std degenerate => MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that R, not falsification. (3) IID synthetic null (same marginal P(S) i.i.d. S_next seed 42) must show BC≤0.03 p>0.10 |null_mean|<0.1. (4) Independent-noise time-shuffle for timescale: shuffled lag null autocorr ~0. All nulls executed with same K analytic Gamma marginal, same grouping, dirt prior alpha=1/K.
measurement_validity: Substrate: no new Gate0 production SPA discovery required; primary datasets: (a) locally-hosted correlated FSM rich-DOM bank (50x40=2000 N=1999, same construction as positive_control but designated primary) substrate_available by construction, and (b) existing BrowserGym WebShop/TodoMVC trajectory bank if available with DOM/AX at 1280x720 (reused, not recollected). Analytically bias-corrected pipeline operates on stored trajectories only; no new browser automation beyond localhost. Gate0 title>=2/H>0.2 NOT gating.

State S_next operational: S_next = SHA256(normalize(URL_after)|'|'|normalize(title_after)) where normalize(URL)=lowercase, strip query ?session=/?token=, preserve SPA hash fragment #/, strip trailing slash; normalize(title)=trim lowercased 200 chars (constant allowed). Report S_URLonly sensitivity. S_next from t+1 distinct from DOM_before at t (no post-state leak). |R|/N expected 0.02-0.15 with richer finite vocab.

Action A_leakageFree operational: A=(primitive,target_sig) primitive in {click,fill,navigate,select,submit,hover} target_sig=role+name+testId+aria-label never href/URL/src; diagnostic A_leaky for leakage gap only; MI(DOM_rich;Action) must be <0.10 else tautology.

History H_K=3 operational: H_K=(A_{t-2},A_{t-1},A_t, S_{t-2},S_{t-1},S_t) last 3 steps; strata key C=(URL_before_normalized, H_K_actions) URL_without_title to avoid leakage; require ≥5 unique C with ≥3 per stratum for CMI; singleton_SA_rate<70%; report H(S_next|C) must be >0.2 for barrier/committor (if ≤0.2 CMI forced 0 => MEASUREMENT_INVALID environment ceiling, not falsification, per 347646 audits).

DOM_rich representations (all richer than hash-truncated 5k SHA256, tested independently): R_visual = AX bounding boxes (x,y,w,h) discretized + element_count/tree_depth/interactive_density; R_computed_style = computed CSS color/visibility/display/opacity; R_event_seq = n-gram of last 3 interaction events; R_AX_embedding = TF-IDF or sentence embedding of a11y names/roles (not truncated hash). Preserve raw observables: dom_bytes, a11y_bytes, visual layout JSON, computed style dict, event seq; hash collision loss disclosed; embedding dimension/clustering via TRAIN-only k-means (k=20). Primary requires ≥1 R.

Estimator: Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial with analytic bias correction: for strata C, H(S_next|C) = log Gamma marginal with alpha=1/K (K=12 default, K=24 exploratory), H(S_next|C,DOM_rich) similarly stratified by (C, DOM_cluster). Observed CMI = H(S_next|C)-H(S_next|C,DOM). Analytic null_mean = E[CMI|perm] closed-form via Gamma ratios, analytic null_std via Dirichlet-Multinomial variance (not permutation variance alone). BC = CMI_obs - analytic_null_mean. Also compute permutation null (1000 grouped) for empirical check: consistency |perm_mean - analytic_mean|<0.03 and calibrated null_std = max(perm_std, analytic_std) with analytic floor. Document K choice and bias floor.

Barrier/committor operational: identify canonical states s where revisits ≥10 (count trajectories hitting same URL_before_normalized + DOM_rich cluster). For each s, collect next-basin futures: label trajectory future as hit A before B within horizon H=10 steps; estimate committor q(s)= #hit_B/(#hit_B+#hit_A). Require ≥5 states with ≥10 revisits and both branches observed (divergent futures) for identifiability (per physics red flags: cluster != attractor). Report revisits table, divergent fraction, basin sizes. Validate calibration: ECE ≤0.15, Brier score vs Markov baselines.

Timescale operational: compute autocorrelation ACF(lag) of DOM_rich embedding or state indicator, and lag-k MI I(S_{t+k}; DOM_t | C). Estimate decay tau via exponential fit tau = -1/log(ACF1). Require tau_correlated >5 vs tau_independent ~1 and BC_lag gap ≥0.05 over shuffle null; report ACF table 0..5.

Permutation: 1000 trajectory-grouped shuffles of DOM_rich labels within each C stratum grouped by trajectory_id seed 42 deterministic; null distribution mean/std/p_raw/p_bonf where p_bonf=min(1,p_raw*n_tests) n_tests≤8 floor 0.001 reachable; resampling unit trajectory_id not transition; no Gaussian jitter; report null_mean, null_std, p_raw, p_bonf, Cohen d=BC/null_std where std>0, 95% CI via grouped percentiles.

Split integrity: TF-IDF vocab / embedding centroids / Dirichlet counts fit on TRAIN trajectories only (70/30 split by trajectory_id grouped 1000 perm); holdout test for accuracy gaps; site identity never feature; leakage check.

Sampling integrity: policy documented (deterministic FSM per trajectory L, 50x40 uniform among primitives, BrowserGym trajectories policy as collected); determinism PYTHONHASHSEED=0 numpy 42; never Python hash() as seed; trajectory_id is resampling unit; latent L correlation per-trajectory vs per-15-step P(flip)=0.07 documented.

Uncertainty integrity: resampling unit trajectory_id; correlated transitions not independent; no Gaussian jitter bootstrap; report CI via permutation percentiles; calibrated null_std via analytic DM, not raw permutation variance alone (fixes prior degeneracy perm_std 0.0097 scaling down with N); degeneracy check is now analytic+consistency, not absolute 0.01 alone.

Representation integrity: raw observables preserved or losses documented (bbox quantization, style discretization, event n-gram truncation, embedding k); derived variables operational meaning validated; tautology checks MI(DOM;Action) <0.10.

Auditability: all raw transitions, richer DOM JSON, strata tables, permutation + analytic distributions, revisits table, ACF table, code paths committed with sha256 in provenance.json; freeze hashes verified before execution; re-executable byte-identical aside elapsed.
decision_rule: Gated execution in order, any triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID and prevents primary evaluation: G1 positive correlated control fails if BC<0.30 OR p_raw≥0.01 OR |null_mean_analytic|≥0.1 OR calibrated null_std degenerate (analytic_std≤0.005 and perm_std≤0.01) OR |perm_mean-analytic_mean|≥0.03 => pipeline_blind_or_miscalibrated (prior hash K=24 BC 0.707 but perm_std 0.00967 degenerate; analytic correction expected to pass). G2 independent-noise replication shows BC≥0.05 and p<0.10 with valid null (|null_mean|<0.1 calibrated std valid consistency<0.03) => pipeline_confounds (cannot distinguish correlation from independent). G3 IID synthetic null BC>0.03 and p<0.10 with valid null => null miscentered. G4 identifiability fails if <5 states with ≥10 revisits and divergent futures OR H(S_next|C)≤0.2 => null_degenerate_no_branching (not falsification). G5 primary analytic-perm consistency fails on BOTH R sets (|perm-analytic|≥0.03) => model_mismatch. If any G fails, verdict=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, publish gate_table, do not evaluate primary. Else primary: for each R in {R_visual,R_computed_style,R_event_seq,R_AX_embedding}, compute BC_R, p_bonf_R (min(1,p_raw*n_tests) n_tests≤8), null_mean_analytic_R, calibrated_null_std_R, BC_sim_R, BC_markov1_R, gap_R=BC_R-max(BC_sim_R,BC_markov1_R), Cohen d_R=BC_R/calibrated_std_R, 95% CI, ECE_R, Brier_gap_R, tau_R and lag-MI gaps. Define sig(R)=1 if BC_R>0.05 AND p_bonf_R<0.01 AND |null_mean_analytic_R|<0.1 AND calibrated_null_std_R valid AND consistency<0.03 AND gap_R≥0.05 AND (ECE_R≤0.15 OR tau gap validated). If EXISTS R with sig(R)==1 => SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST — richer DOM barrier/committor or timescale reveals beyond-memory predictive structure on existing bank without Gate0, with valid analytic centering and calibrated null, gap over similarity/Markov while independent stays ~0, bounded to tested FSM + WebShop bank and richer reps. If FORALL R, BC≤0.05 OR p≥0.01 OR gap<0.05 OR calibration fails while gates pass => FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING — richer DOM does not carry detectable predictive information beyond (URL,H_K,Action) and similarity/Markov via barrier/committor/timescale with analytic correction, bounded to tested richer reps and existing bank, closing hash-truncated degeneracy thesis.
